planner_response.task: Place the left bowl into the center bowl, then place the right bowl into the resulting stack.

limits.enforcement: Check measured LINK6 displacement across every action. Reject unreachable or clearance-failing waypoints rather than changing IK.

assumptions: Bowls are upright circular vessels, initially supported by the visible tabletop.
The fitted upper-back circle represents the rim.
A world-down, 5 mm shallow rim insertion is a bounded interaction hypothesis, tested by an active lift.
Observed coordinated motion supports a temporary no-slip hypothesis, not proof of attachment.
An aligned gravity-assisted release may produce nesting; it does not guarantee nesting.
unknown: Actual wall thickness, cavity depth, material, friction, contact state, true dimensions and true poses.
assumptions_and_unknowns.uncertainty_policy: Reported sensitivities describe conditional visual conditioning, not certified errors or confidence intervals. Robot-to-object offsets are trajectory/search predictions only, never object measurements.

coordinates_and_geometry.closing_axis: World X; outward sign s=-1 for the left source and s=+1 for the right source.

center_receiver_seed.requirement: Obtain a second wrist view before planning receiver-relative transport.

coordinates_and_geometry.height_estimation: At initial support, set H=measured rim_z-table_z independently for each source. This estimates rim-to-lowest-supported-bottom height under the support assumption, not cavity depth. Recompute from accepted fits; report 10 mm height perturbation sensitivity as an engineering robustness test, not a certified uncertainty.
coordinates_and_geometry.pad_reference: P is the midpoint between the opposing actual pad contact surfaces at their common shallow contact level. Derive T_LINK6_to_P from public finger meshes and measured aperture; do not treat a fingertip or LINK6 origin as P.
coordinates_and_geometry.orientation: Use public finger geometry to align insertion world-down and closing world-X, with one pad inside and the other outside. Maintain this orientation throughout loaded motion.

initial_and_receiver_fit.model: Two-view calibrated reprojection fit with free XYZ and independent radius for each bowl; upright normal is an explicit assumption.
initial_and_receiver_fit.radius_range_meaning: Engineering plausibility gate only; never force equal radii.
initial_and_receiver_fit.failure_action: Acquire one alternate wrist view within the stage budget; otherwise STOP.

source_tracking_under_occlusion.model: Use its own accepted two-view radius as a fixed prior only when a free-radius current fit is poorly conditioned.
source_tracking_under_occlusion.required_report: Current residual, XYZ sensitivities, visible arc, radius-prior usage and prior age.
source_tracking_under_occlusion.prohibition: Do not substitute gripper pose plus stored offset for a missing source fit.

freshness.receiver_partial_validation: Within 3 steps, observe at least 45 degrees of receiver rim with RMS <=2 px against its retained fit.
freshness.receiver_invalidation: Any visible displacement >5 mm, unexplained reprojection shift >3 px, contact-like disturbance, or loss of identity requires a new two-view fit.
freshness.expired_data_action: HOLD and observe; do not continue blind transport.

approach_and_entry.support_rule: Use current cavity/rim visibility and projected public finger meshes to validate an inside/outside straddle. This is an image-space operational gate, not cavity-depth certification.
approach_and_entry.no_contact_requirement: No invented wall-thickness, force or contact test is required before the shallow grasp attempt.

motion_clearance.unrelated_bowl_proxy: Use each fitted rim radius plus 20 mm and its supported-height hypothesis plus 10 mm as a visual exclusion proxy; not a certified physical envelope.
motion_clearance.target_exception: The selected source at pinch and selected receiver at release are excluded only from their intended interaction region.
motion_clearance.failure_action: HOLD, reobserve and replan within budget; STOP if no accepted route exists.

waypoint_formulas.notation: C and R denote fresh measured source rim center and independently fitted radius; D denotes the current receiver top-rim center; H is the source supported-height hypothesis; eX=[1,0,0], eZ=[0,0,1].

receiver_observation.midpoint: M=(initial_left_C+receiver_high_view_ray_intersection_with_z_plane(initial_left_C.z))/2; the ray intersection is only a camera-aiming hypothesis.
receiver_observation.orientation: Point calibrated camera optical axis toward M, with roll chosen nearest the current camera roll.
receiver_observation.selection: Use the first reachable candidate satisfying public-mesh clearance, image visibility and two-view baseline gates; otherwise try the second. Refit receiver XYZ and R rather than retaining the ray-plane seed.
receiver_observation.arm: Unloaded right wrist for the first operation; a safely positioned unloaded wrist for subsequent observation.

rim_pinch.open_pad_positions: Use measured gap and actual pad meshes about P_entry. Confirm the inner pad projects inside the visible cavity and the outer pad outside the bowl.
rim_pinch.entry: Descend from P_approach to P_entry with fine actions; do not increase the nominal insertion beyond 5 mm.

active_lift.command: After one CLOSE step, issue the lift without requiring prior source rise.

loaded_prediction.command_mapping: P_target=C_target+o, converted to LINK6 using the public pad transform.
loaded_prediction.measurement_rule: Refresh C from images. Use o only to predict motion and search regions.

carry.path: Raise vertically before horizontal transfer. Maintain the source's accepted upright pinch orientation.

above_rim_lower.fine_lowering: Move vertically toward C_release only after measured XY alignment passes.
above_rim_lower.uncertainty_report: Report g_est, source-Z sensitivity, receiver-Z sensitivity, table sensitivity and the 10 mm height perturbation separately. Their sum may be reported as a sensitivity budget, never as a guaranteed interval.

retreat_and_park.after_release: OPEN, then raise P vertically by 0.080 m before lateral retreat.
retreat_and_park.fallback: If the lateral target is unreachable, remain at the last reached clearance-accepted height/Y and move outward only as far as reachable. Exact initial-pose return is unnecessary.

sequence: Capture a current pre-lift source fit and measured pad pose.
Issue a 20 mm world-up lift over up to 10 physical steps with grip HOLD.
Acquire at least three source observations spanning at least 6 steps, including after the lift.
Use remaining steps for a brief HOLD and one viewpoint adjustment if necessary.

acceptance.interpretation: Independent RGB motion and stable measured relative position authorize candidate transport, not certified holding.

transport_no_slip_monitor.requirement: Fresh source observations at least every 3 steps; source motion must agree with commanded transport over a rolling window of at least 5 steps.
transport_no_slip_monitor.failure_action: Stop translation immediately. Reobserve; lower to a visually clear supported recovery location only if current source tracking remains available.

active_lift_test.failure_before_transport: If the bowl remains supported or clearly slips, return vertically to the recorded pinch height, OPEN, retreat 30 mm and reobserve. Never tighten repeatedly based only on aperture.

release_gates.direct_receiver_support: Require a current receiver rim arc >=45 degrees and visible cavity evidence in at least one calibrated view. If the source occludes the cavity, obtain that evidence within 5 steps immediately before final alignment, then retain current rim validation.
release_gates.cavity_evidence: At least 100 visible cavity pixels and the projected source center inside the visible rim-supported opening model with a nominal 10 mm inward margin.
release_gates.meaning: These measured gates authorize a candidate above-rim drop, not guaranteed clearance, nesting or contact.

release_and_inspection.release_command: Issue one OPEN step, maintain pose briefly, then begin vertical retreat. Do not push the bowl down into the receiver.

post_release.requirement: After retreat, obtain two-view free XYZ+R fits of the newly placed top rim and visible receiver structure. Track the released source visually; do not infer its location from the hand.
post_release.first_operation_advance: Proceed only if the released left bowl is visibly supported over the center receiver, remains stable, and its top rim has a fresh accepted independent fit. It becomes the second receiver.
post_release.unclear_result: Use bounded additional observation. If support, identity or stable placement remains unclear, STOP without declaring success.
post_release.final_report: Report observed rim alignment, stability, visible bowl identities and any occlusion. Do not claim certified nesting or infer a hidden bowl count.

stages_and_budgets.accounting: All motion, OPEN/CLOSE/HOLD, settling, active observation and recovery physical steps count. Images without a physical step do not consume extra steps. Unused budget may remain unused.

initialization.actions: OPEN both hands first; verify measured aperture, measured robot state and public-mesh clearances; preserve or move to safe observation poses.

order.action: Acquire source and receiver two-view geometry and validate pinch visibility.
One native CLOSE step; aperture is diagnostic only.
Lift first, then test independent visual motion.
Raise, then translate with current source tracking.
Align and lower to the nominal 30 mm bottom-gap hypothesis.
Vertical separation followed by lateral parking.
Observe settling and refit the released top rim before advancing.

each_operation.operation_1: Left arm, left source, center receiver; right hand remains unloaded and clear.
each_operation.operation_2: Right arm, right source, freshly refitted left-bowl top rim as receiver; left hand remains parked.

shared_recovery.rule: Retry only with fresh geometry and a clear supported source. If recovery cannot fit its remaining budget, STOP.

stages_and_budgets.timeout_rule: At a phase or global budget limit, stop safely without declaring completion. HOLD a potentially loaded hand; do not blindly OPEN.

minimal_actor_interface.responsibility: External code computes perception, geometry, clearance, freshness and phase gates. The actor chooses categorical error signs, grip command and phase decision; it does not certify geometry.
minimal_actor_interface.error_definition: Desired minus measured. Use measured pad pose for approach/entry/retreat, independently measured source center for loaded translation, and measured pad orientation for rotation. Invalid errors are null and require UNKNOWN signs.
execution_rules: External code selects 1..5 physical steps and bounded motion magnitude; the actor does not output continuous controls.
ADVANCE requires the external phase-ready gate; STOP overrides all motion.
Use OPEN before entry, CLOSE exactly once in the close phase, HOLD while lifting/carrying, and OPEN only at authorized release or supported recovery.
Do not infer holding from aperture, source rise from robot motion, or task success from ADVANCE.

compiled_notes: Development candidate, not a frozen or successful policy. Raw Pro response retained verbatim.
Existing categorical signed-axis compiler is reused; primitive enter maps to insert and active lift maps to transfer with a separate metric co-motion gate.

Source tracking uses fresh circular-rim XYZ with an independently earlier RGB radius and2mm radius perturbation. Six material texture tracks are NOT implemented or fabricated; current three-dimensional rim motion is the alternative lift evidence. This deviation needs empirical validation.

Nominal straddling and5mm shallow insertion are conditional visible-hollow-bowl interaction hypotheses. No3px inner-cavity contour certificate is implemented or claimed; no cavity depth/wall thickness is invented.
Whole-hand table sweep and30mm inter-hand AABB separation are checked. Full-arm/scene collision proof and unknown object envelopes are not claimed.
Active receiver observation stops on an accepted actual two-view fit, not only a camera pose. Unloaded-hand floor is table+80mm, leaving about30mm nominal clearance above initial rim.
Closure waits for measured aperture settling after native CLOSE; source capture is tested only by active lift. Close/open may consume several physicalsteps.
Current receiver consistency is checked every action; retained stationary receiver estimate expires after20steps. Robot-relative offsets are search predictions, never current object measurements.
First operation deadline400, second780, global800 include all observation/setup/transit/settling. No automatic recovery or grasp retry is currently implemented.
Robot recipe completion is kept separate from full visual/native task success; native outcome remains outside both model inputs.
